universe.name: 1980s Retro-Tech Felt & Cardboard Office Diorama
universe.why: Felt and corrugated cardboard capture the physical, clunky reality of running a real-world shop, which contrasts deadpan against the concept of a highly advanced AI system learning mundane bureaucracy.
universe.pacing: Methodical, rigid, and deadpan, resembling a dry corporate HR training video.
universe.signature_shot: The small felt penguin wearing a miniature stiff fabric blazer and red tie, holding a tiny clipboard next to a giant felt CRT monitor.
universe.medium_break: A fuzzy felt monitor spits out a glossy, perfectly realistic thermal paper receipt.
universe.look_bible: 1980s Retro-Tech Felt & Cardboard Office Diorama. Medium: densely textured wool felt electronics and figures, rigid corrugated cardboard desks and shelving, stiff fabric clothing. Palette: beige, drab office grey, muted teal, warm tungsten orange. Lighting: harsh overhead fluorescent strips (softened by the wool texture), glowing CRT green screens. Lens: sharp macro with shallow depth of field, highlighting the fuzz on the felt and the ridges of the cardboard. Motion: rigid stop-motion stepping.
universe.penguin_render: Small round egg-shaped Adelie-type penguin, bottom-heavy. Black head and back, white belly. Big round white eye-rings, small dark beak with an orange tip, slightly oversized bright orange feet. Three thin stubborn feathers sticking up from its head. Rendered entirely in textured wool felt.
universe.music: Plucky woodwinds, muted synthesizers, and rhythmic typewriter percussion.

penguin.arc: A loyal customer who gets absorbed by the AI's bureaucracy, eventually becoming a middle-management clone.

shots.motion: The camera pushes in steadily as the cardboard door swings open on its hinges.
The camera drifts forward through the open doorway, settling on the softly glowing felt monitor.
The camera slides smoothly right to the corrugated shelf as felt soda cans pop firmly into place.
The camera pushes in slightly as the heavy felt cube drops heavily, bending the cardboard shelf downward.
The camera tilts up smoothly from the heavy cube to reveal the hanging cardboard discount sign.
The camera pulls back steadily, revealing the absurdly long line of felt workers waiting behind the penguin.
The camera pushes in slightly as the tiny cardboard delivery box pops onto the desk in front of the monitor.
The camera pushes in further as the stiff fabric blazer and tie drop awkwardly onto the monitor.
The camera tilts up sharply to the top of the monitor as the red felt exclamation mark pops up.
The camera tracks smoothly right, following the tiny envelope sliding across the corrugated desk to the empty security station.
The camera pushes in steadily on the blueprint as the jagged line graph plummets downward.
The camera pushes in slightly as the massive felt Boss monitor slams down heavily onto the desk next to the small one.
The camera slides right, revealing the towering mountain of felt paperwork piling up rapidly next to the monitors.
The camera pushes in tight on the penguin as it stands completely still in its new middle-management attire.
